boundary: Bounded deterministic RV32IMC-free CSR/fence RVFI differential. The permitted CSR is mscratch (0x340) with full 32-bit read/write storage; fence and fence.i are architectural no-ops. MIE/interrupts are disabled. Counters, time and all other CSR/system operations are excluded.
claim: Bounded local Verilator and independent-reference evidence. Manufacturing and foundry signoff remain open.
comparison: Independent Python RVFI reference versus repaired CV32E40P; PC, instruction, order, GPR writes, memory address/masks, next-PC transitions, and selected mscratch CSR effects are compared.
open_gates: synchronized PMP and fault differential coverage
larger randomized campaigns and broader CSR scale-up
